minimum_constraints: Inherit the active formal Plains tile/style family and actual UnderworldPlayer as the project baseline; distinguish rejected historical proposals from currently used shared production assets
Keep the current 16px/32wu ratio, pixel clusters, edge/light language and nearest filtering coherent; preserve 47 core and exact non-grid edge adapter without changing proven collision
Allow Forest bark/moss/thorns/root/cavity materials, topology, ecology and colors as region-specific extensions; same style does not mean identical palettes or grass textures

Every region create/optimize and document-only missing-Bible proposal receives the same version/SHA-bound supplemental user instruction and actual baseline references; same upstream drift/resume rules apply
Use the existing G2 whole-game normal-scale cross-region comparison and independent review; metadata/SHA/47 masks do not certify consistent pixels or user aesthetic approval
planned_counterexamples: omit or partially forge style supplement in handwritten region mission
keep supplement hash but change actual baseline PNG/atlas/TileSet/shader bytes
change supplement or baseline reference before call, during worker or before resume; preserve failure/counters/checkpoint
remove shared reference from a missing-Bible proposed task or any later region input
correct baseline metadata but visible high-resolution overpaint hides it: must fail actual consumer/pixel review, not pass from hashes alone
organic Forest root silhouettes at the existing pixel scale with legitimate regional materials: positive case, must not be rejected solely because shapes/colors differ
unrelated precise Player/global action/document changes: no new style/image gate
two original Bibles normalized/rewritten to insert correction: reject; use additive supplemental authority instead
prior_audit_invalidation: The earlier Plains gap report repeated the now-corrected rule excluding active Underworld from creative input; that specific inference is superseded, while its static gameplay consumer inventory remains scoped. Original report is retained, not silently rewritten.
